items.question: Which widgets can I use in marketplace templates?
items.answer: Only widgets from LandTech Extras (free) and LandTech Extras Premium. This FAQ uses the FAQ Accordion widget with FAQPage JSON-LD enabled.

items.question: Does the accordion output schema automatically?
items.answer: Yes. Turn on FAQPage schema in the widget settings and the FAQPage structured data is printed with the questions and answers.

items.question: Can more than one item stay open?
items.answer: Accordion mode keeps a single item open. Turn accordion mode off if you want multiple answers visible at once.

items.question: How do I restyle the questions?
items.answer: Use the Style tab on the FAQ widget for typography, colors, icon position, and spacing. The markup stays accessible.

items.question: Will this conflict with another FAQ schema plugin?
items.answer: Disable the widget schema if another plugin already prints FAQPage JSON-LD on the same URL.

items.question: Can I nest this inside a pricing or support page?
items.answer: Yes. Import this section below a pricing table or contact block. The schema still describes the six questions on the page.
